content: macOS Apple Silicon benchmark methodology: sudo purge forces disk-cache purge but is limited on M-series (reclaims only ~50-800MB, evicts inactive pages only); thermal-history bias in sequential thread sweeps measured up to 54% on fanless machines - mitigation is round-robin scheduling + median across rounds; pmset -g therm and macmon give thermal state without sudo (powermetrics needs sudo); fan-cooled minis hold peak frequency (USENIX M1 study), passively cooled are thermally constrained; +6.6% result shrank to 3.5% when re-measured back-to-back (baseline thermal-history lesson)
